assignments.goal: Use the second fundamental form of the determinantal manifold in the probability simplex to control its contraction with log p by the pullback Fisher metric. Seek an exact Gauss-type identity or a new universal compensation theorem; go beyond the known covariance-only obstruction.

Construct a signed Boolean-cube velocity and acceleration for an arbitrary affine Hermitian kernel path, then adapt displacement-concavity arguments to turn entropy curvature into edge squares. Resolve the exact obstruction from complex off-diagonal directions.

Study mixing two gauge-invariant quasifree fermionic states by a beam splitter whose output covariance is affine. Try to prove a measured-occupation entropy inequality strong enough to give Lyons, retaining the dephasing correction explicitly.

Interpret frozen entropy curvature as a mixed exterior form with a primitive decomposition. Try to derive Fisher compensation for its positive direction from Hodge-Riemann or Alexandrov-Fenchel inequalities, first beyond rank-two support.

Connect determinant-atom logarithms with self-concordant barriers and hyperbolicity cones. Seek an integrated barrier inequality that proves the complete entropy Hessian sign, while bypassing the known failure of pointwise resolvent positivity.

Exploit the exact one-positive-direction reduction in old-097 and C077 through reverse Cauchy-Schwarz or hyperbolic distance. Derive a closed scalar inequality proving the remaining unrestricted three-site obstruction.

Express the entropy curvature defect through relative-entropy loss under occupation dephasing. Construct a recovery or conditional-expectation identity whose remainder has the sign required for affine covariance concavity.

Use coherent-state or Berezin-Lieb inequalities on exterior Fock space to compare affine covariance interpolation with occupation measurement. Derive a concrete integral representation with a controlled measurement correction.

Build an entropic interpolation or stochastic control whose marginals are the determinantal affine-kernel path. Identify a convex action yielding the exact Shannon curvature inequality, or solve a new noncommuting subclass.

Construct a filtration of projection or quasifree states for which entropy increments telescope and the affine-kernel acceleration becomes a predictable nonnegative bracket. Control changing conditional Bernoulli weights.

Polarize a matrix affine direction into scalar stable-polynomial variables and use a multivariate Shepp-Olkin argument. Retain off-diagonal motion and prove the new local derivative inequality it requires.

Find an Alexandrov-Fenchel inequality for the signed mixed discriminants of complementary determinant atoms that pays the logarithmic curvature cost. Target all directions with inertia (2,1) before generalizing.

Use Berezin or Grassmann integration to pair the dangerous determinant second derivatives with Fisher terms. Produce a real nonnegative representation, with complex conjugation and positivity fully justified.

Represent a new family of DPP affine paths through transfer-current networks and prove its entropy concavity using series-parallel elimination or effective resistance. Go beyond established fixed projection substitutions.

Use sequential Bernoulli conditional entropies to prove the complete three-site claim. Derive cancellation between varying pivot weights and the two-site conditional perspectives without imposing the old LMI domain.

Extend the rank-two-support entropy proof to a fixed three-dimensional support using the four cardinality layers and three-vector exterior identities. Seek a full theorem for arbitrary active 3x3 Hermitian matrices.

Prove general submodularity of occupation entropy under adding orthogonal projection modes using a new coupling or information identity. Isolate its exact consequence for two varying eigenvalues against arbitrary backgrounds.

Use representation theory of the Johnson scheme or discrete Hodge decomposition to solve the five missing harmonic constraints in general six-site projection diamond couplings. Avoid the disproved fixed-Gram SOS ansatz.

Construct a phase-aware nonnegative diamond coupling from complex Plucker relations, allowing nonlinear or piecewise weights. Target fully supported six-site flags outside phase-frame and Fourier-rotation classes.

Use matroid intersection, valuated matroids, or exchange flows to realize all four marginals of a projection diamond. Derive a determinant-specific Hall inequality sufficient for the general six-site case.

Develop a joint operator-perspective inequality for a moving Bernoulli pivot and its two Schur-complement kernels. Seek the exact finite Jensen correction that closes unrestricted conditional induction.

Prove a nonperturbative family on a five-vertex path with independently moving leaf means and central links, using paired conditional corrections. Then determine whether the argument inducts over trees.
Construct a new message-passing potential for tree-sparse Hermitian kernels whose local entropy Hessians telescope despite changing conditional means. Aim at full tree-supported affine concavity.
Extend the balanced-star theorem to arbitrary balanced bipartite kernels using singular-value blocks and a matrix Laplace integral. Include non-star-supported directions if the identity permits.

Extend C077's three-site diagonal phase-damping entropy production to all dimensions via cycle cumulants or quantum Markov generators. Determine whether a polarization controls general affine directions.
Decompose the full Hessian into atom-visible and gauge-null components on graph cycle space. Derive a dimension-independent negative-square formula or a new complete four-site class.

Construct a phase randomization coupling which lowers the dangerous Hessian Schur scalar while preserving required invariants, avoiding C014's failed canonical-phase maximization. Seek unrestricted three-site transfer.
Formulate determinant occupation entropy as an entropy term in a noncommutative Brascamp-Lieb inequality. Obtain a sharp local inequality including both measured Fisher and curvature correction.
Choose a DPP-adapted Markov generator whose entropy dissipation matches the affine Hessian. Prove a curvature-dimension or modified logarithmic Sobolev estimate that supplies the missing sign.
Refine the count-uniform spectral entropy envelope by conditioning on a partition or sufficient statistics. Find a touching concave envelope at new arbitrary or nonexchangeable bases.
Use H(p)=inf_f(log sum exp f - E_p f) to build concave variational representatives in K. Derive a useful class of dual potentials whose determinant expectations have the required sign.

Construct an adaptive complete statistic family using exterior minors whose Fisher projection exactly controls the frozen term. Prove a dimension-free completion inequality beyond failed linear and parity statistics.
Develop a determinantal Stein operator for arbitrary Hermitian parameter derivatives and integrate by parts to express negative entropy curvature as squares plus controllable commutators.

Use symmetric logarithmic derivatives and measured score projections to identify a positive operator representing the full entropy Hessian. Seek an operator inequality stronger than data processing alone.

Use tropical determinant valuations to classify all three-site boundary degenerations, including arbitrarily separated eigenvalue scales and missing coordinates. Derive a uniform positive metric that could support a complete compactification proof.

Blow up singular strata of the three-site contraction cone so logarithmic Fisher divergences become monomial. Prove a uniform sign on a previously uncovered boundary stratum, with explicit overlap to interior regions.

Find a convergent cycle-cluster resummation for the Shannon Hessian whose signs survive arbitrary complex cycle products. Replace C071's positive-cycle restriction with a Fisher budget for negative clusters.
Represent log determinant atom coefficients by loop measures or loop-erased walks and pair frustrated loops with score fluctuations. Prove a new strong-coupling class beyond signed-Stieltjes odds.
Use planar networks and total-positive Grassmannians to construct entropy-curvature certificates for full-rank noncommuting kernels. Identify an affine-convex domain with genuinely new scope.
Study an operator-valued free or Boolean convolution analogue that retains occupation information, and seek a finite-dimensional identity transferring entropy concavity back to affine DPP kernels.
Find an ancillary lift that converts arbitrary kernel directions into already-controlled low-rank directions while changing occupation entropy only by an affine term or a concave correction.
Construct a projection dilation with a parameter-independent measured channel and prove a convexity sign for its conditional entropy correction. Avoid the known both-sign canonical-dilation shortcut.

Seek a measured fermionic Stam or de Bruijn identity for two arbitrary input kernels, beyond diagonal-reference paths. Derive a Fisher inequality sufficient for the ordinary Shannon concavity conjecture.

Use quasifree quantum Markov conditions and strong subadditivity to prove affine occupation-entropy concavity on a new graphical or low-treewidth class, keeping classical measurement effects explicit.
Develop a clique-separator entropy potential for chordal-sparse kernels with separators of size two. Establish a full nonperturbative affine family beyond trees and two-coordinate blocks.

Interpret determinant atoms as volume-sampling experiments and the entropy Hessian as information gain curvature. Use equivalence theorems or matrix design duality to construct a global positive certificate.

Derive entropy curvature directly from a sequential DPP sampler with parameter-dependent transition kernels. Find a choice of sampling order or randomized pivot that makes all correction terms nonnegative.
Build a localization process preserving determinantal structure whose drift is affine covariance motion. Express the conjecture as a supermartingale and prove the necessary bracket estimate.
Represent DPP occupation events through Gaussian or complex Gaussian exterior volumes and use a comparison inequality to control entropy interpolation, including normalization and dependence exactly.
Use singular-value interlacing and conditional eigenvalue laws to extend count entropy concavity to basis-sensitive subset entropy. Target a concrete rank-three or four-site theorem.

Construct a majorization order on all principal-minor atom vectors compatible with affine kernel chords. Seek an intermediate law whose entropy gives both endpoint weights without asserting false atom majorization.
Translate determinant subset weights to mixed volumes or mixed areas and seek a logarithmic Alexandrov-Fenchel entropy inequality with the exact Fisher compensation.
Use spinor coordinates or Bogoliubov transforms to simplify the three-site positive direction without changing occupation entropy. Derive an invariant scalar formula and prove its sign.

Develop an analytic logarithmic-mean inequality adapted to the eight feasible three-site atoms that proves the complete Lorentzian Schur criterion. Avoid replacing the feasible atom domain by arbitrary distributions.
Prove unrestricted preservation of a full-Hessian entropy sign under positive diagonal odds scaling, or a new compensated flow that can move any three-site kernel into a proved region.
Use Sinkhorn-type scaling of K and I-K or complementary atom balancing to reduce a general kernel to a count-uniform or central base while preserving the required curvature inequality.
Close C070's threshold-straddling gap for positive diagonal directions by splitting conditional pairs at their individual thresholds and proving a global cancellation identity.

Prove the DPP-specific mixed-sign version of independent-set amplitude concavity beyond general-channel counterexamples. Use negative association or stable-polynomial structure to control the cross terms.
Construct a noncommuting conditional-replacement channel calculus with a positive commutator correction. Apply it to two arbitrary coherent endpoint kernels or a new full-rank block family.

Generalize projection diamond couplings to a common random flag permutation with entropy corrections when exact marginals cannot all be realized. Show the correction still proves two-eigenvalue concavity.
Remove the fixed projection-background restriction from the rank-two active-matrix theorem by integrating Bernoulli spectral backgrounds while controlling mixture entropy curvature exactly.
Construct a three-step or cube coupling of projection laws that controls all rank-three active directions. Prove the needed entropy orientation bound with higher-dimensional incidence geometry.
Find sharp dimension-free entropy inequalities for middle layers of projection flags, improving the rank-dependent diamond constants so active two-mode concavity works against arbitrary bottom rank.
Use Chow rings or Lorentzian polynomial Hessians to derive a nonlinear entropy inequality for projection basis distributions, aimed at the missing orientation or diamond bound.

Choose a latent sufficient statistic for eigenmode occupations that splits measured entropy into a concave spectral part and a controlled channel-information term. Prove the required sign for a new non-count-uniform family.
Find a less-noisy or Blackwell-order comparison between projection sampling channels along eigenbasis changes that controls the conditional-count entropy deficit under affine kernels.

Interpret occupation scores as posterior expectations of spectral Bernoulli scores. Use posterior covariance identities to bound the lost Fisher information and changing-eigenvector correction simultaneously.

Use sharp fermionic occupation uncertainty inequalities for paired bases to compensate the entropy loss under dephasing. Produce a quantitative affine-kernel Hessian inequality rather than a static lower bound.

Seek an integral of operator-monotone divided differences that represents the complete compensated Hessian, allowing cancellations in the integration variable that failed pointwise-resolvent methods miss.
Investigate higher derivatives of determinant occupation entropy under positive shifts to establish a Bernstein-function representation strong enough for mixed affine directions in a new kernel cone.

Design a flow on kernels whose conditional Schur complements are affine and whose acceleration has a favorable entropy derivative. Use it to compare an arbitrary affine chord with a provably concave path.

Construct a dimension-inductive Bellman function agreeing with occupation entropy on DPPs and having the required joint concavity under one-coordinate Schur updates. Explicitly solve the three-site Bellman boundary problem.
Derive an evolution equation for the largest entropy-Hessian eigenvalue under diagonal noise or a scaling flow. Use boundary negativity and a maximum principle to exclude a positive interior maximum.
Find a heat or Ornstein-Uhlenbeck-type evolution of kernels that transports the full Hessian sign backward from a diagonal or count-uniform endpoint with a closed differential inequality.
Integrate the known rank-one directional concavity through a carefully chosen decomposition of general directions, controlling mixed derivatives by a new polarization or parallelogram inequality.

Treat rank-one concavity versus full concavity through null Lagrangians and quasiconvexity. Seek a determinant-specific rigidity theorem forcing the missing mixed Hessian entries to obey the desired sign.
Use the 2x2x2 atom tensor and its Cayley hyperdeterminant to parameterize three-site feasibility and entropy curvature. Derive an exact sign certificate retaining complex-cycle information.
Develop an orthogonal Walsh-feature factorization of the full three-site or four-site Hessian with logarithmic means. Seek an analytic positivity decomposition on the whole feasible domain.

Use hypercontractivity or reverse hypercontractivity for determinantal occupation laws to dominate second-order score chaos by first-order Fisher energy. Specify the determinant-dependent constants needed for concavity.
Prove a Poincare-type inequality for the frozen log-atom potential against the kernel score, including the quadratic acceleration. Target rank-three directions or arbitrary three-site kernels.

Use discrete Ricci curvature of a projection exchange chain to control flag entropy differences and hence active-mode curvature. Prove an exact finite flag inequality beyond standard spectral-gap estimates.

Solve the dual of the six-site diamond feasibility problem through convex entropy potentials or nonlinear min-cost flows. Derive determinant-specific dual inequalities instead of searching primal numerical couplings.
Apply three-lines or multivariate complex interpolation to a suitable norm of determinant atom vectors, differentiating at Shannon exponent one. Retain the correct affine Hermitian parameter path.

Construct a rigorous local-in-exponent representation of sum p^q that yields Shannon curvature although Renyi concavity fails away from one. Isolate a q-1 cancellation with a positive derivative certificate.
Model DPP outcomes by correlated categorical selections and derive an exact entropy chain rule whose mixed second derivatives pair as two-outcome log-sum inequalities.
Seek an entropy Brunn-Minkowski inequality for random exterior volumes that maps exactly to occupation probabilities of affine contractions, with a sharp equality classification.
Extend the pair-interaction Cauchy odds theorem to arbitrary Cauchy shapes or a larger integrable kernel family using determinant identities and exact Fisher allocation.
Exploit displacement-rank identities to prove affine entropy concavity on a new non-count-uniform Toeplitz or circulant family at arbitrary coupling strength.

Find a finite-state transfer-matrix representation for an affine family of DPP kernels and prove entropy concavity by a matrix recursion. Ensure the path is affine in K rather than only in odds parameters.
Build a fermionic tensor-network representation of the compensated entropy Hessian and use reflection positivity or local contractions to show its sign on a new graph class.
Use particle-hole reflection or chessboard estimates to control frustrated even cycles and extend the balanced bipartite theorem beyond stars, with explicit complex phases.
Express the affine Jensen deficit as an integral or expectation of conditional mutual informations. Construct the missing joint law rather than relying on a formal signed mixture.

Develop a uniform metric across all projection-boundary strata with independently vanishing insertion and hole scales. Resolve invisible adjacent-cardinality features by retaining higher-order scores.
Prove a full-Hessian gluing theorem for arbitrary weak block links whose leading quartic form is degenerate, using higher-order conditional score geometry without genericity assumptions.

Reduce the three-site entropy Schur criterion to finitely many analytic extremal configurations using Lagrange multipliers and feasible atom geometry. Prove an extremal reduction rather than merely optimizing numerically.
Derive a set-indexed analogue of Hillion-Johnson's local inequality incorporating complex off-diagonal derivative data. Show precisely how its summed form yields Lyons entropy concavity.
Construct a martingale coupling of endpoint determinant laws and the interpolated kernel law with an entropy-increasing conditional refinement. Target arbitrary two noncommuting three-site endpoints.
Find a decomposition of the exact entropy Hessian into weighted log-sum inequalities whose weights are nonnegative determinant identities. Aim for a universal symbolic template, first on three sites.

Use completed X001-X094 results to combine two independently developed field connections into a stronger proof. Root will supply the specific live bottleneck before launch; do not perform an audit or summary-only task.

Use the strongest unresolved scalar or operator inequality from this campaign and introduce a genuinely different mathematical tool to close it. Root will specify the target at launch; deliver new derivation, not review.
